content: Per-app DB provisioning against a shared/external Postgres: movetokube/postgres-operator manages databases+users on an EXTERNAL Postgres server from k8s CRDs (Postgres + PostgresUser), generating a k8s Secret with credentials per user — this is the closest match for LXC-hosted shared Postgres. CloudNativePG's Database CRD only applies to clusters it manages in-k8s (out of scope here). Alternatives: scaffolding-time SQL script/Ansible creating db+role, or Crossplane provider-sql. The user expectation from PaaS platforms (Heroku, Coolify, Dokploy) is 'app gets a database automatically'.
